title: Our School
subtitle: 考点：方位介词 / There be / 校园设施
passage: Our school is large and beautiful. The main building is in the middle of the school. In front of it, there is a sports field. We do exercises there every morning, and we raise the flag there on Monday.
The dining hall is across from the main building. The food there is delicious. The library is at the back of the school. It is quiet and has a lot of books.
vocab: building 建筑物 · in the middle of 在……中间 · in front of 在……前面 · across from 在……对面 · sports field 运动场 · dining hall 餐厅 · do exercises 做操 · delicious 美味的

options: In front of the sports field.
In the middle of the school.
At the back of the school.
